tooltip: Camera Mode – Select master operation or externally controlled trigger exposure.
Orientation Mode – Flip the image horizontally and/or vertically.
Gain Mode – Select automatic or manual gain and configure automatic-gain behavior.
Exposure Mode – Select automatic or manual exposure and enter the manual exposure time.
Anti Flicker Mode – Select 50 Hz or 60 Hz flicker mitigation, or disable it.
Strobe Mode – Enable or disable the strobe output.
Image Burst – Select the number of images captured in one burst.
Target Brightness – Set the brightness target used by automatic exposure.
Exposure Compensation – Apply an exposure-time compensation value.
Read Statistics – Read the active exposure time and sensor gain.
Read Temperature – Read the current sensor temperature in degrees Celsius.
Fast Auto Exposure – Configure fast AE, target brightness, and execution frames.
Self Trigger – Configure automatic sensor triggering and its detection thresholds.
Detected Pixels – Configure the bright and dark detected-pixel counts.
Default – Restore all extension-unit controls to their factory defaults.
ISP Firmware Version – Read the camera ISP firmware version.
